statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: AUTOMOTIVE SUPPORT SERVICES TO IMPROVE SAFE TRANSPORTATION ACT OF 2025
statements.title: AUTOMOTIVE SUPPORT SERVICES TO IMPROVE SAFE TRANSPORTATION ACT OF 2025
sentences: Gary Gordon has truly dedicated his life to our country in uniform as an EMT, and as a mental health worker at our State hospital for more than two decades.
Mr. Speaker, I rise today in support of a bipartisan bill that I am very proud to be leading with my colleague and friend, Congressman Barrett.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: ECONOMIC POPULISM
statements.title: ECONOMIC POPULISM
sentences: He said that there is a right of every businessman--businesswoman, too--large and small, to trade in an atmosphere of freedom from unfair competition and domination by monopolies at home or abroad.
It has been said on the floor of this House and on the floor of the United States Senate that monopolies are inconsistent with our form of government.
Just like political power, economic power has to be checked, too, but the fact is that big corporations and monopolies have too much power in America today.
I come to Congress having worked in the Department of Justice in the Antitrust Division.

I hear about big health insurers who are charging people more for less, big health insurers who are rolling up the entire industry, from providers to hospital beds and to the prescription drugs that people rely on for their lives.

Our antitrust laws are alive and well, but they could use an update, and I look forward to working with everyone here today and in the days ahead to make that dream a reality because it is core to the American Dream.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: SMALL BUSINESS ADVOCACY IMPROVEMENTS ACT OF 2025
statements.title: SMALL BUSINESS ADVOCACY IMPROVEMENTS ACT OF 2025
sentences: I have traveled all across New Hampshire and heard directly from small business owners and employees about the concerns they have about the use of tariffs, which are an important tool in leveling the economic playing field, but they will have a real impact on our small businesses in New Hampshire.
Mr. Speaker, I rise in support of H.R. 832, the Small Business Advocacy Improvements Act.

In Congress, I am fighting every single day to ensure that New Hampshire small businesses get true advocates and a seat at the table in trade negotiations and discussions that impact our international and interconnected economy.
